title: 2027 ACM Awards Changes Include New Criteria for New Artist Categories & Song of the Year
summary: Also, see the new category that has been added.
contentText:
The Academy of Country Music Awards have amended criteria for a number of categories for both its artist and industry awards. Additionally, the ACM has finalized the submission and voting timeline for the 62nd ACM Awards, which will take place May 16 in Las Vegas.

For the artist awards, the changes include broadening the criteria for the new artist of the year awards, which are presented in new male, new female and new duo or group categories. The wording has been altered to “presented to a country music individual artist, duo, or group who gains initial notoriety and demonstrates significant creative growth and development in overall consumption or chart activity, live performance, and/or national media recognition during the eligibility period,” according to the official description of the award.

Previously, a more restrictive definition noted that the recognition occurred “during the promotion of a debut or sophomore album within the eligibility period,” and specifically defined chart activity as “must have released a single that reached the top 50 on Billboard’s Hot Country Songs or the Mediabase Country charts.” Significantly, the new definition removes the album requirement in a nod to how release patterns have changed to focus on consumption. A qualifier that any albums self-released through an independent label operated by the artist would not be counted as a debut or sophomore album unless it produced a top 50 single has also been removed.

For song of the year, eligibility is now “limited to newly created compositions recognized as distinct copyrighted works, including those that incorporate elements of existing songs while contributing to substantial original songwriting.”  The “newly created compositions” language is new.

For songwriter of the year, whose nominees are selected by a professional panel of judges composed of songwriters, publishers, producers and performing rights organization representatives, the panel will now submit 10 nominees, up from the five nominees in years past.

The ACM has also amended some of the criteria for its industry awards, most significantly, adding a new category, international event of the year. According to the award language, “This award is presented to an outstanding country music festival, fair, or rodeo held outside the United States.” The event must span at least two consecutive days and feature a minimum of 10 acts with no fewer than 75% of the mainstage line-up classified as country acts.

Additionally, the industry awards have combined the two casino categories—formerly casino of the year (theater) and casino of the year (arena)—into a single award renamed casino venue of the year. The definitions for the Don Romeo buyer of the year and promoter of the year awards have been revised to further detail the contributions of the talent buyer and promoters, though the criteria hasn’t substantially changed.

“The ACM Awards have always been about celebrating the artists, songwriters and industry professionals who make country music what it is today, while recognizing the next generation shaping its future,” said ACM CEO Andy Schuon , in a statement. “As our genre continues to grow and reach audiences around the world, it’s important that our awards evolve alongside it. From updated new artist of the year criteria that recognize the unique paths emerging artists take to build their careers, to the introduction of international event of the year and refinements to our industry categories, these updates reflect the breadth, momentum and global reach of country music today.”

Below are the submission and voting timelines for the 2027 ACM Awards and the ACM Radio Awards:

ACM Awards Voting Timeline

- Eligibility Period:  Jan. 1, 2026 – Dec. 31, 2026

- Submissions Period: Jan. 4-25, 2027

- First Round Voting:  Feb. 22 – March 8, 2027

- Second Round Voting:  March 22 – April 5, 2027

- Final Round Voting:  April 19 – May 3, 2027

ACM Radio Awards Voting Timeline

- First Round Voting:  Feb. 2 – Feb. 16, 2027

- Second Round Voting:  Feb. 23 – March 8, 2027

For the full definition of eligibility criteria, go to the ACM Awards website .
